observed_pattern: In all five examples, a displacement and a slope threshold exceedance occurs in 7–8 of 8 windows, with activations generally spanning from 10.0 h to 45.0 h and short coherent-sign runs of 2–5 windows.

Residual variability is above threshold in 8/8 windows in every example; sample-to-sample changes occur in 5–6/8 windows, while simultaneous residual and difference exceedances occur in 5–6/8 windows.
